mapper.select: SELECT id, expense_request_id as expenseRequestId, eligible_count as eligibleCount, required_count as requiredCount, approve_count as approveCount, reject_count as rejectCount, status, version, created_at as createdAt, expires_at as expiresAt FROM woorido.expense_votes WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, expense_request_id as expenseRequestId, eligible_count as eligibleCount, required_count as requiredCount, approve_count as approveCount, reject_count as rejectCount, status, version, created_at as createdAt, expires_at as expiresAt FROM woorido.expense_votes WHERE expense_request_id = #{expenseRequestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.expense_vote_records WHERE expense_vote_id = #{voteId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'APPROVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as AGREE, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'REJECT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as DISAGREE, COUNT(*) as TOTAL FROM woorido.expense_vote_records WHERE expense_vote_id = #{voteId}
